title: ABT: Long 41 sh at $102.97. A 7% peer discount plus a 2.4% yield, with the Q3 print on 10-21 as the test
call_reason: The published 12-month target ($110.01) and the research target (12m) of $114.08 sit above the $102.97 price at medium conviction, though the edge is modest (P(gain) 0.60) and the research supervisor's confidence is low.
one_liner: Abbott trades at 17.8x NTM consensus EPS against a 19.15x peer median. Earnings are guided up and the main NEC claims are settled and already deducted, so we see $110 in 12 months (+6.8%, plus a 2.4% yield) and $114 research target (12m). The 2026-10-21 Q3 print has to show the ~9% second-half comparable-growth ramp the full-year guide implies; we buy half before it and half after.

thesis.point: ABT is cheap against its peers even after the settlement news. Our base case keeps most of that discount, so we are not counting on a re-rating.
thesis.evidence: At $102.97, ABT trades at 17.8x a blend of FY2026/FY2027 consensus EPS ($5.52 / $6.07). Derived: 102.97 / (0.504 x 5.52 + 0.496 x 6.07 = 5.793) = 17.8x. The one-basis peer median is 19.15x, so ABT sits ~7% below it (estimate). This discount was measured after the August NEC settlement: the stock closed at $111.25 on 2026-08-14, the week before the 8-K, and is 7.4% lower now. The research target (12m) uses 17.5x true-NTM EPS of $6.45 (estimate), which keeps most of the discount.

thesis.point: Earnings visibility is improving. The FY2026 guide went up at Q2, consensus sees ~10% EPS growth in FY2027, and Exact Sciences dilution shrinks and then turns accretive.
thesis.evidence: FY2026 adj. EPS guide: $5.55-5.80 in January, cut to $5.38-5.58 in April (including $0.20 Exact dilution), then raised to $5.45-5.60 at Q2. FY2027 consensus EPS is $6.07 (+9.92%). The Exact deal deck guides dilution of $0.20 in 2026 and $0.16 in 2027, and accretion in 2028 and beyond. Q2 comparable sales grew +4.8% after Q1's +3.7%.

thesis.point: The largest legal overhang is now sized and deducted in full in our research target (12m).
thesis.evidence: The 2026-08-20 8-K resolved the $495M Gill verdict plus claims of ~2,000 more infants for ~$670M in aggregate; ~1,700 suits covering ~12,700 infants remain. Abbott won summary judgment in the first three federal MDL bellwethers. The research target (12m) deducts $1,314M after tax in expected legal costs, which is -$0.76/share (estimate): -$530M for the August settlement, -$304M for the accrued Q2 $385M reserve, and -$800M x 0.6 for the remaining claims, divided by 1,734M horizon shares.

variant_view: No strong variant view: this is a valuation-gap and carry trade with a modest edge. We are below the Street. Our $110.01 target is 8.9% under the $120.72 sell-side mean (median $120, 28 analysts, range $103-135, 'Strong Buy'). That mean implies ~19.9x FY2027 consensus EPS of $6.07 (derived: 120.72 / 6.07), which is above the 19.15x peer median. We hold ABT at 17.5x because the causes of its discount persist into the horizon NTM window. Medicare CGM competitive bidding takes effect 2028-01-01; Nutrition and Established Pharma were 29% of Q2 sales ((2,144 + 1,499) / 12,593); NEC claims remain; and FDA has posted no close-out letter for the January 2026 Libre warning letter. Against the options market we are slightly more positive. The options-only distribution centres on $107.39 with P(gain) 0.559; the blended distribution (67% options, 33% research) gives $110.01 and 0.597, the research-only view $114.40 and 0.676. The allocation engine scores the research edge as small: conviction multiplier 0.59, t-stat 0.62. (Sources 1, 8, 12, 15-17, 26-28.)

valuation.methods: Supervisor's reconciled research target (12m) is $114.08, an estimate from the run's model engine: 0.4 x DCF $117.03 + 0.6 x P/E $112.12. DCF inputs: GAAP EBIT margins 17/17/18/19% for FY2026-29 (FY2026 applied only after 6/30); WACC 7.6% from the 5.19% 10-yr and Damodaran's 4.20% implied ERP; terminal growth 3%; net debt of $27,005M at 2026-06-30 (3,005 + 29,603 - 5,104 - 499, 10-Q) rolled forward at 4.4%. P/E leg: 17.5x x $6.45 true-NTM adj. EPS = $112.88, less $0.76/share expected legal costs. The five agents' research targets (12m) range $110.22-115.42. Scenarios are bear $85.37 / base $114.08 / bull $130.13 at 25/50/25, a mean of $110.92. The published $110.01 target is the median of the blended options-and-research distribution. Upside is derived: 110.01 / 102.97 - 1 = +6.84% to target, 114.08 / 102.97 - 1 = +10.79% to the research target (12m). The $0.63 quarterly dividend adds ~2.4% (0.63 x 4 / 102.97 = 2.45%). (Sources 2, 13, 14, 19, 26, 27.)

catalysts.event: Record date for the $0.63 quarterly dividend (payable 2026-11-16); StockAnalysis lists the same day as the ex-dividend date
catalysts.why_it_moves: The price drops mechanically by about the dividend on the ex-date. A buyer on or after the ex-date does not receive this payment.
catalysts.watch: The open versus the ~$102.34 dividend-adjusted reference (102.97 - 0.63). Judge the first tranche's entry against that level, not $102.97.

catalysts.why_it_moves: This is the main test of the thesis. The FY2026 comparable-growth guide of 6.5-7.5% needs roughly 9% growth in H2 after H1's 4.3% (supervisor estimate), and FY2027 consensus of $6.07 assumes the ramp holds. The blended 1-month distribution gives only P(price >= $102.97 on 2026-11-13) = 0.486, so we have no edge on the sign of the move.
catalysts.watch: Q3 comparable sales growth against the ~9% H2 need. Q3 adj. EPS against the $1.38-1.46 guide. Whether the $5.45-5.60 FY range is held, narrowed or cut. Nutrition (Q2 -3.1% reported) and Libre/Diabetes Care trends. Any first FY2027 framework against $6.07. The GAAP charge for the ~$670M August NEC settlement, which was unaccrued at 6/30 and is already known.

catalysts.event: Boston Scientific Q3 2026 results (electrophysiology/PFA peer read)
catalysts.why_it_moves: A read on electrophysiology demand and pulsed-field-ablation share in ABT's medical-devices business.
catalysts.watch: BSX EP growth and commentary on competitive PFA launches.

catalysts.event: DexCom Q3 2026 results, after the close (CGM peer read)
catalysts.why_it_moves: A read on CGM category demand, the largest growth driver for ABT's Diabetes Care unit, and any update on CMS coverage for non-insulin type 2 patients.
catalysts.watch: US CGM growth, pricing commentary and DexCom's view of CMS coverage timing.

catalysts.event: Possible CMS decision to widen Medicare CGM coverage to non-insulin type 2 patients
catalysts.why_it_moves: Abbott's CEO called it a possible 'multibillion-dollar opportunity' that 'could happen in the fall' but would not forecast a date. DexCom expects to hear from CMS before year-end, with coverage from mid-2027. It is not one of the supervisor's valuation inputs.
catalysts.watch: A CMS proposed or final coverage decision, and its effective date and eligibility criteria.

catalysts.event: Abbott's US commercial launch of Freenome's SimpleScreen CRC blood test (FDA-approved 2026-07-27)
catalysts.why_it_moves: It adds a blood-based colorectal screening option alongside Cologuard. The launch is small relative to ABT's sales, so it matters mainly as a signal for the diagnostics strategy.
catalysts.watch: The launch announcement, pricing and reimbursement.

catalysts.event: Annual dividend increase decision (last year announced 2025-12-12: +6.8% to $0.63)
catalysts.why_it_moves: A signal of board confidence while net debt stays elevated after the Exact Sciences deal.
catalysts.watch: The size of the raise against last year's 6.8%.

catalysts.event: Q4 2026 results and first formal FY2027 guidance (Q4 2025 results came on 2026-01-22)
catalysts.why_it_moves: The FY2027 guide sets the EPS base for the horizon valuation ($6.45 true-NTM). Last January's initial FY2026 guide ($5.55-5.80) was cut in April, so guide credibility is in play.
catalysts.watch: The FY2027 adj. EPS guide against $6.07 consensus and the $0.16 of 2027 Exact dilution in the deal deck, FY2027 organic growth, and Nutrition's return to growth.

catalysts.why_it_moves: The first quarter of the FY2027 guide. Last April's print came with a guidance cut.
catalysts.watch: Whether the FY2027 guide is held, organic growth versus guide, and progress on deleveraging.

catalysts.event: Possible Section 232 tariff action on imported medical equipment (investigation opened 2025-09-02)
catalysts.why_it_moves: Tariffs on imported devices could raise ABT's costs. Action was expected no later than mid-September 2026, and as of 2026-10-15 the Federal Register lists no Section 232 proclamation on medical equipment (the Section 232 proclamations it lists since August cover drones and polysilicon). It carries no value in the supervisor's numbers.
catalysts.watch: A presidential proclamation or Commerce announcement, its scope (glucose monitors, consumables) and any exemptions.

catalysts.event: Remaining NEC preterm-formula claims (~1,700 suits, ~12,700 infants)
catalysts.why_it_moves: Further settlements or plaintiff verdicts could reprice the residual liability. We carry -$800M after tax x 0.6.
catalysts.watch: New settlement batches and their implied cost per infant, new state-court trial dates, and federal MDL rulings.

catalysts.event: FDA follow-up on the January 2026 Libre warning letter (close-out or escalation)
catalysts.why_it_moves: Class III PMAs tied to the violations are not approved until the problems are corrected, which gates CGM product approvals.
catalysts.watch: An FDA close-out letter, a re-inspection outcome, or any new Libre recall.

risks.risk: The H2 ramp fails. If comparable growth stays near H1's 4.3% instead of the ~9% the FY2026 guide needs, the FY2026 range gets cut and FY2027 EPS of $6.07 resets lower. The supervisor ties a sustained trade below its $80 thesis break to a 10%+ FY2027 EPS reset.
risks.signpost: Q3 (2026-10-21) comparable growth well below ~9%, the 6.5-7.5% FY comparable guide narrowed to the low end or cut, or FY2027 framing below $6.07.

risks.risk: NEC costs run above the ~$1.0B pre-tax residual we assume for the ~12,700 remaining infants.
risks.signpost: A settlement batch implying well above ~$110k per infant (12,700 x $110k = ~$1.4B, derived), or new large state-court plaintiff verdicts.

risks.risk: Libre quality problems escalate. The Class I recall of Libre 3 / 3 Plus sensors involved 7 deaths and 860 serious injuries, and FDA has posted no close-out letter for the January 2026 warning letter; together they could hit CGM share and approvals.
risks.signpost: A new recall, a failed re-inspection, delayed Class III approvals, or Diabetes Care growth slowing in the Q3 or Q4 prints.

risks.risk: Medicare CGM competitive bidding cuts pricing: national remote-item delivery, payment at the 75th percentile of winning bids, effective 2028-01-01 and inside the horizon NTM window. Abbott's Medicare CGM revenue is not disclosed in any source the run verified, so it carries no dollar adjustment.
risks.signpost: The CMS bid-window schedule and the single payment amounts, with awards expected in late summer to early fall 2027.

trade.position: 41 sh (~$4,222, 17.6% of the ~$23,933 book; re-sized from 22 sh on 2026-10-15 after the conviction rubric change)
trade.entry: Supervisor plan: two tranches. Buy 20 sh now, on the 2026-10-15 ex-dividend day (we do not get the $0.63; reference ~$102.34). Buy 21 sh after the 2026-10-21 Q3 print, once the H2 comparable ramp is visible. Sizing note: the supervisor suggested capping the name at 6% (~14 sh) and building in two steps. The book no longer applies per-name caps, so the size is set by the book-level Sharpe test (binding constraint sharpe_gate), which gives 41 sh. ABT's correlations to the tech-heavy holdings are low (rho -0.13 to NVDA, -0.08 to AVGO, 0.07 to GOOGL; beta 0.58). (Sources 9, 18, 19, 26, 28.)
trade.exit_or_add: Exit on a close below the $82.51 stop (15th percentile; ~$839 loss on 41 sh), on a sustained trade below the $80 thesis break, or if Q3 shows the ramp failing and the FY guide is cut. Take profit at $130.57; the chance of touching it (0.44) is higher than the chance of touching the stop (0.35). The decider's ladder: add to 46 sh at $97.82 with no new news; at $92.67 (52 sh) add only after a news check; trim to 37 sh at $108.12 and to 33 sh at $113.27 (news check). (Sources 26-29.)

what_changes_our_mind: Q3 on 2026-10-21. Comparable growth well short of the ~9% H2 need plus a cut to the $5.45-5.60 FY range means we skip the second tranche and re-run the research. Comparable growth at or above ~9% with the guide held or raised and FY2027 color at or above $6.07 means we complete the position.

NEC. A new settlement batch or verdicts implying well above ~$110k per remaining infant (more than ~$1.4B pre-tax for ~12,700 infants, derived) means our -$800M x 0.6 residual is too small and we cut. A global settlement inside that range removes most of the overhang and supports moving toward the $114 research target (12m).

Libre and CMS. FDA escalation (a new recall or a failed re-inspection) means we exit. A warning-letter close-out or a CMS decision widening Medicare CGM coverage to non-insulin type 2 patients is upside not in our numbers, and would make us add on weakness.
